ns2:course.label: Diseases of Field Crops
ns2:course.description: Studies the symptoms of major field crop diseases, life histories of causal organisms, and methods of control. Lecture and laboratory. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: CPSC 212.
